name: openbb_company_news
description:
Recent news articles about one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.news.company).
Returns: {symbol, articles: [records with date, title, text or summary, url, source and provider extras]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (one ticker or comma-separated tickers); limit (number of articles; when omitted the tool asks for 10, the schema says 5); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts benzinga, fmp, intrinio, polygon, tiingo, yfinance; default benzinga, which needs a key; yfinance needs none).
Market-wide news: openbb_market_news; other source: yf_news. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 5, "provider": "yfinance"}
